title: Where Do Animals Live? Animal Homes for Kids with Milo
description:
Where do animals live? Travel with Milo the bluebird to the hot desert, the snowy Arctic, the bamboo forest, the rainy jungle and the mountains. Is this the animal's home, yes or no? Find the real home of the arctic fox, the panda, the monkey and the bear, and see why they live there.
An interactive animal homes lesson for kids ages 2-6, with questions to answer, actions to copy and a quiz at the end.
facts: Arctic foxes live on the Arctic tundra; their coat is white in winter and turns brown or gray in summer for camouflage (Britannica; Columbus Zoo).
Giant pandas live in cool, misty bamboo forests in the mountains of China and eat almost only bamboo (Smithsonian's National Zoo; WWF).
Many monkeys are tree-dwelling and live in tropical rainforests (San Diego Zoo; Britannica).
Many bears spend the winter resting in a den (U.S. National Park Service).

segments.name: hello
lines: Hello, friends! I am Milo the bluebird.
Today we are going on a big trip!
Every animal has a home. Some homes are hot. Some homes are cold.
Four animal friends are coming with us. One, two, three, four!
Let's find out where they live. Are you ready? Let's go!

segments.name: arctic_fox

lines.t: Where does the arctic fox live?
Does the arctic fox live here, in the hot, sandy desert?

lines: No! Too hot for a fluffy fox. Let's try again.
The arctic fox lives in the snowy Arctic! Brrr!
teach
Here is the fun fact. In winter, the arctic fox is white, like the snow.
But in summer, when the snow melts, its fur turns brown!
exhibit
White in winter, to hide in the snow. Brown in summer, to hide in the rocks.
exhibit
And its thick, fluffy fur is one of the warmest coats in the whole animal world!
close:arctic_fox
Say it with me. White in winter, brown in summer!
close:host
Can you curl up like a fox in the snow? Curl, curl, curl!
So cozy!

short.title: Arctic Foxes Change Color! White in Winter

segments.name: panda

lines.t: Does the panda live here, on the hot, grassy savanna?

lines: No! Nothing yummy for a panda here. Let's try again.
The panda lives in the bamboo forest!
teach
Here is the fun fact. Pandas live in cool, misty bamboo forests, high in the mountains.
exhibit
Why bamboo? Because bamboo is a panda's favorite food. It eats bamboo almost all day!
A panda's thick fur keeps it warm in the cool, wet forest.
close:panda
Say it with me. Pandas live in the bamboo forest!
close:host
Can you munch like a panda? Munch, munch, munch!
Great munching!

short.title: Where Do Pandas Live? In the Bamboo Forest!

segments.name: monkey

lines.t: Does the monkey live here, in the warm, rainy jungle?

lines: Yes! The monkey lives in the jungle!
close:monkey
Here is the fun fact. Many monkeys live high up in the jungle trees.
exhibit
They eat in the trees, play in the trees, and sleep in the trees!
exhibit
A long tail helps a monkey balance on the branches.
Up in the trees there are sweet fruits and crunchy leaves to eat.
close:monkey
Say it with me. Monkeys live in the trees!
close:host
Can you swing your arms like a monkey? Swing, swing, swing!
Super swinging!

short.title: Monkeys Live High in the Jungle Trees!

segments.name: bear

lines.t: Where does the brown bear live?
Does the bear live here, in the hot, sandy desert?

lines: No! Too hot for a furry bear. Let's try again.
The brown bear lives in the mountain forest!
teach
Here is the fun fact. In winter, many bears sleep in a cozy den.
exhibit
They snooze through the cold, snowy days, until spring comes back.
exhibit
In spring, the bear wakes up very, very hungry. Time to find some berries!
Say it with me. Bears sleep in a den in winter!
close:host
Can you yawn and stretch like a sleepy bear? Yawn. Stretch!
What a sleepy bear!

short.title: Bears Sleep in a Den All Winter! Animal Homes

segments.name: quiz
lines: Wow! We visited four animal homes. Now it is quiz time!
Get ready. Think hard!
quiz: Who lives in the snowy Arctic, and turns brown in summer?
Who lives in the bamboo forest?
Who lives high in the jungle trees?
And who sleeps in a den in winter?

segments.name: goodbye
lines: You learned four new things today.
Curl up like a fox. Munch like a panda. Swing like a monkey. And stretch like a bear!
Where is your home? Is it hot or cold today?
Thank you for traveling with me. Bye-bye, friends! See you next time!
